desc: Study the splat terrain frame draw (chunk culling, per-frame cbuffer, vertex buffers, VS) in SplatTerrainDiligent.cpp and the glTF shadow caster (gltfDiligentShadowDraw + shadowDiligentCasterBias); record the caster contract and a depth-only caster design for the splat pass in notes.md.
result: Caster contract and design (approach A) recorded in notes.md: reuse splat VS + chunk vbo/ibo with depth-only PSO, cCamView=transpose(W2L)/cCamProj=I/anchor, cascade-frustum culling via frustumCullFromVP, no rasterizer bias.

desc: Implement splatTerrainShadowDrawDiligent(ctx, cascadeWorldToLightProj, dsv) in SplatTerrainDiligent.{h,cpp}: lazy depth-only PSO on the existing splat VS (D32, 0 color RTs, NO rasterizer bias, bind SetRenderTargets(0, nullptr, dsv, TRANSITION) first to drop the glTF caster's dummy RTs), shadow-frame staging cbuffer with per-cascade cCamView=transpose(W2L), cCamProj=identity, g_Anchor=camera anchor, cascade-frustum culling of anchored AABBs via frustumCullFromVP (no 1-chunk camera window), guarded no-op unless the same gate+load+TAA conditions as splatTerrainDrawDiligent hold.

Wire the terrain caster into renderCascadesImpl in ShadowDiligent.cpp: call it once per cascade after gltfDiligentShadowDraw, guarded by splat-pass availability (no behavior change when ENGINE_SPLAT_TERRAIN=0 or not loaded).

Verify/fix the terrain shadow *receive* path in PCF mode: check splatShadowsOn gating, ShadowMapIndex/slice/WorldToLightProjSpace/depth bias in the splat cbuffer, and confirm the single player-anchored cascade covers the terrain correctly.

Build and verify: run the verification command, check the /tmp/terrain_shadow.jpg screenshot for terrain casting (player/props onto terrain, terrain self-shadow) and receiving shadows; use ENGINE_SHADOW_READBACK=<frame> to confirm cascade depth now contains terrain, and ENGINE_PBR_BIAS_SCALE at 1/2/4 to tune acne/peter-panning on the receiver side (caster draws without rasterizer bias, so all tuning goes through the receiver bias).

Regression-check the non-splat path: ENGINE_SPLAT_TERRAIN=0 run (shadow pass unchanged, player still casts) and ENGINE_SHADOW_NO_PLAYER=1 run (isolates the terrain caster's contribution in screenshots).
